item.title: Welcome Back 2025 at Icon South Beach
item.description: Miami, FL - December 11, 2025 - Residents of Icon South Beach gathered for the annual “Welcome Back to Season” celebration on the building’s pool deck. The evening featured cocktails, food, music, and a lively social atmosphere, offering neighbors the chance to reconnect after the summer months. The event officially marked the start of a new season at Icon South Beach. The post Welcome Back 2025 at Icon South Beach appeared first on World Red Eye.

item.title: Paw Portraits at MCM Aventura
item.description: Miami, FL - December 13, 2025 - MCM Aventura teamed up with Amanda Brooke of From Apple to Orange to host Paw Portraits, a dog-friendly event supporting Hurley's Heart Bulldog Rescue.
